title: Demand Rider Sheet: Demand Charges, Ratchet and Power Factor under Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Demand billing terms of Electric Service by Rate Schedule.** A demand charge is billed only on a schedule whose demand rate is above zero. The kW of billing demand above the free demand allowance are charged at the demand rate. The ratchet sets a floor on billing demand at a percentage of the highest metered demand of the preceding billing periods it looks back over, and the power factor adjustment, where the schedule carries it, applies when the measured power factor is below the target.

| Term | R | RS | FH | GS-1 | GS-3 | IR | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Demand charge per kW of billing demand | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $7.25 | $6.10 | $12.40 |
| Free demand allowance (kW per period) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 | 0 | 0 |
| Ratchet floor (percent of the highest metered demand looked back over) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 75 |
| Preceding billing periods the ratchet looks back over | 11 | 11 | 11 | 11 | 11 | 11 | 11 |
| Power factor adjustment applies | No | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Power factor target (percent) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |

Column key: R is Schedule R Residential Service; RS is Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service; FH is Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; GS-1 is Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; GS-3 is Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service; IR is Schedule IR Irrigation Service; LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

### Points of reading

- Schedules R, RS, FH and GS-1 carry a demand rate of $0.00 and bill no demand line at all.
- Schedule GS-3 charges $7.25 per kW only for the kW above its 10 kW allowance; Schedule IR charges $6.10 per kW and Schedule LP $12.40 per kW from the first kW.
- Only Schedule LP has a ratchet (75 percent) and a power factor adjustment. The look-back length of 11 preceding billing periods and the 90 percent target are listed for every schedule but bite only where the ratchet or adjustment exists.

### Hypothetical example — Schedule GS-3

A Schedule GS-3 period with 38 kW of billing demand (hypothetical) is charged for the 28 kW above the 10 kW allowance at $7.25, which is $203.00. A period with 9 kW of billing demand is below the allowance and its demand charge is $0.00.
